items.alt: Lifelong learning - apprendimento permanente - formazione continua

blocks.html:
Given the fast and ongoing changes in our society, it has become crucial to learn new notions, skills and abilities and acquire new personal experiences throughout our lives. This is where the concept of continuing education comes into play — a principle embraced by USI, which offers a range of programmes designed to develop essential knowledge and abilities for professional growth..

EXPLORE THE CONTINUING EDUCATION OFFER AT USI:

  • Continuing education for high school teachers

    Based on an agreement between the Department of Education, Culture and Sport (DECS) and USI, high school teachers in the Canton of Ticino have the opportunity to attend a selection of USI courses.

    Participation grants a certificate valid for fulfilling the teachers’ obligation to complete recognised continuing education activities.
